rename.to: Child route data is not inherited from parent unless 'runGuardsAndResolvers' returns true

body:
Updated title to indicate that this is an issue with the route data only getting updated if `runGuardsAndResolvers` is `true`. That's the root cause and the input binding is just a result of that.

Simpler reproduction: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-pmzfx5?file=src%2Fmain.ts
Suppose this should be a relatively easy fix then? Can give it a shot if you give me some pointers.

> Suppose this should be a relatively easy fix then?

 😅 

>  Can give it a shot if you give me some pointers.

Data resolution / inheriting data from the parent happens here:
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/main/packages/router/src/operators/resolve_data.ts

That, however, depends on an aggregation of guards/resolvers in a previous step:
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/e1728a2a392aa7fa237a50561469f99eb201a24c/packages/router/src/utils/preactivation.ts#L102C11-L105

I think the preactivation.ts and its shouldRunGuardsAndResolvers seem fine (since the resolvers are being run correctly as is), rather, the data population is incorrect in the resolve_data.ts, since it doesn't propagate the data to any child routes, which it probably should.

The way I see it now, runResolve function will need to be changed so that it only computes the _resolvedData (the resolved data of just the route that owns the resolver) and resolveData function will need to be changed so that it does a second pass after calculating all _resolvedData so that it goes through all the routes which just got their _resolvedData recalculated and all their children down until it reaches leaves and extends routes' data according to paramsInheritanceStrategy as it traverses. That however would go against eventually allowing the data to be read from other resolvers as described in #47287.

Still don't see where the ActivatedRoute.data gets invalidated though.

issue.title: fix(router): propagate resolver data to children even when their 'runGuardsAndResolvers' returns false

issue.body:
The current way of computing a route's params and data recomputes inherited data from the inheritance root every time. When the inheritance strategy is "emptyOnly", this isn't necessarily the root of the tree, but some point along the way (it stops once it reaches an ancestor route with a component).

Instead, this commit updates parameter inheritance to only inherit data directly from the parent route (again, instead of recomputing all inherited data back to the inheritance root). The only requirement for making this work is that the parent route data has already calculated and updated its own inherited data. This was really already a requirement -- parents need to be processed before children.

In addition, the update to the inheritance algorithm in this commit requires more of an understanding that a resolver running higher up in the tree has to propagate inherited data downwards. The previous algorithm hid this knowledge because resolvers would recompute inherited data from the root when run. However, routes that did not have resolvers rerun or never had resolvers at all would not get the updated resolved data.

fixes #51934
